sprites.name: ironward-v2
sprites.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: real frame-by-frame pixel-art combat sprite sheet for a game, not a lineup or illustration. EXACT REGULAR GRID of 8 columns and 8 rows =64 frames on a square transparent canvas. NO gaps between grid cells, NO drawn grid or labels. Every frame uses precisely the same square cell size. Camera is HIGH rear overhead, looking DOWN at 60 degrees, so top of helmet and shoulders are prominent, foreshortened adult realistic proportions; NOT eye level, NOT side-on. All frames have a common centered ground anchor, entire weapon and body within the cell with 15 percent empty margin. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, muted dark fantasy materials, serious detailed non-cartoon style.
Rows 1-4 show the same teal-accented warrior facing UP screen, seen from BACK ABOVE. Row1: eight distinct frames of a RUN cycle, opposite arms and legs alternating, cloak moving. Row2: eight progressive frames of LIGHT ATTACK: ready, turn and windup, arm drawn back, swing begins, contact full extension, follow-through, withdraw, ready. Row3: eight progressive frames of HEAVY ATTACK with pronounced full-body anticipation, powerful impact and recovery. Row4: eight progressive DEATH FALL frames: recoil, buckling knees, tipping forward, hands to ground, collapsing, body settling, prone corpse, same prone corpse.
Rows5-8 repeat those exact actions but warrior now faces DOWN screen, seen FRONT ABOVE, with muted crimson cloth accents: row5 run, row6 light attack, row7 heavy attack, row8 death fall. Fixed camera, same character scale throughout; feet/ground anchor at each cell center-bottom. Animations must show substantial DIFFERENT limb poses through each sequence. No background, no shadows, no text, no scenery. Transparent outside the sprites.
CHARACTER: Sword and round shield warrior, closed steel helmet, weathered chain mail, short dark teal mantle. Light attack is a broad one-handed horizontal sword slash while the shield stays near chest. Heavy attack raises sword over the shoulder then downward cleaves. Compact readable silhouette. Do NOT reuse reference pose: render new top-rear perspective and animation poses.

terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: overhead terrain textures for a massive pixel-art army battle. Landscape 3:2 image containing exactly TWO columns and TWO rows of equal rectangular environments, no borders. Every quadrant viewed from HIGH ABOVE at 65 degrees looking down, almost top-down orthographic strategy game view. NO HORIZON, NO SKY, no distant mountains on skyline. Broad flat textured battlefield fills at least central 85 percent of each scene, with tiny environment objects at far edges only. Top left muddy autumn grassland with wheel ruts, subtle stones, dead grass, a tiny palisade at very top edge. Top right icy snow field with footprints, cracked slate, small frozen shrubs and top-edge stone fort walls. Bottom left dark marsh mud with shallow puddles, broken paving, patches of reeds at corners. Bottom right volcanic dark ash and basalt ground with small glowing cracks at outer edges. Consistent fine PIXEL ART, small pixel clusters, desaturated earthy cinematic gloomy palette. Readable low contrast ground so hundreds of tiny warriors stand out over it. NO characters, NO lettering, NO interface. This is ground seen beneath armies, not a scenic landscape painting.
